_spec_note: The task spec assumes PyTorch; this benchmark is 100% JAX/Flax(nnx). SCOD & SLL are implemented natively in JAX against the existing JAX checkpoints so the base predictive mean is preserved bit-for-bit and the existing JAX evaluator is reused. torch_version/cuda_version -> jax_version/jaxlib_version; .pt sketch/posterior files -> .npz.
submitted_table_seed_subset_note: Original NeurIPS submission + Luigi default gym_tasks.py:1732 => {0,10,200} on {Ant,HalfCheetah,Hopper,Humanoid}. Later rebuttal sensitivity work standardized on {0,10,42}. AMBIGUOUS - confirm before producing the submitted-subset aggregate.

validation_split_hashes.rule: ID val = RandomState(99).permutation(10000)[:1000]; env-independent (matches base-training val split)

test_split_hashes.rule: held-out ID test = full id_eval tier (10000 rows) file results/{env}/data_id_eval_seed{seed}_steps10000.npz

model_output_contract: ProbabilisticRegressionModel (models.py:192): MLP hidden_dims=[200,200,200,200] relu, dual heads -> (mean, var); var=softplus(var_head)+1e-6. Predicts next-state (out_dim) from [state,action] (in_dim). Heteroscedastic diagonal Gaussian (SCOD Case B).
aleatoric_variance_convention: Sigma_a(x)=diag(var(x)) with var=softplus(var_head)+1e-6 (metrics add +1e-6 again in NLL, metrics.py:11).
predictive_covariance_convention: diagonal moment-matched total var = mean_members(var) + var_members(mean) (_predictive_mean_var, util.py:112). Uncertainty score for AUROC/Spearman = mean over output dims of total predictive variance (run_sensitivity build_eval; util.py:256).
